content: We choose an LSTM module for the CWS task. Raw input Chinese text is converted from characters to vectors with character-positional input embeddings pre-trained by BIBREF5 over 112,971,734 Weibo messages using word2vec BIBREF18. Detailed parameter settings can be found in BIBREF13. The embeddings contain 52,057 unique characters in a 100-dimension space.
